senses.gloss: to be silent, dumb, at rest; to be stricken dumb.
units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 33:1">Pesik. R. s. 33</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 6:5">Is. VI, 5</cite>) <he>היאך היה לי שדָּמַמְתִּי</he> how did it happen to me that I was silent (did not join in the praises of the angels)? <cite ref="Taanit 20a:14">Taan. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>דָּמְמוּ הרוחות</he> when the winds subside.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 91a:17">Snh. 91ᵃ</cite> <he>כאבן דּוּמָם</he> like a dumb stone.
Ber. 19ᵃ יושב ודוֹמֵם sits in silence; a. fr.—Part. pass. דָּמוּם, f. דְּמוּמָה.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:37">Lam. R. to I, 17</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="A00377"><he>אֶדַּדֵּם</he></cite>, <cite ref="Psalms 42:5">Ps. XLII, 5</cite>) <he>ועכשיו ד׳ סלקא וכ׳</he> and now in silence does she (Israel) go up (to the ruins of Jerusalem), and in silence &c.—V. <cite ref="D00874"><he>דִּמְדֵּם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>ודמו</he> <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:10">ib.</cite>) [read:] <he>ובלבד שתִּדּוֹם וכ׳</he> provided that thou leavest off from the sin &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 627">Yalk. ib. 627</cite>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 29">Ex. R. s. 29</cite> end <he>ה׳ כל העולם</he> He made the world stand still.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 97:4">Gen. R. s. 97</cite> <he>שהוא מַדְמִים וכ׳</he> who will bring to a standstill sun and moon.
